name: Florentino

identityAndPortrayal.preservedDossier: Llanero coplero in liquiliqui and sombrero with a cuatro over the shoulder. His contrapunteo adaptation sends a note that follows rival height while retaining horizontal direction. Existing reference preserved; no new broad historical research or likeness edits.

cpuFight.method: Real engine, complete510-tick intro, deterministic controller in the audit test. Florentino opens with special, allows180 calls for CPU offense, then approaches, guards, jumps and attacks. Run twice and compare full final match states.
cpuFight.limitation: Scripted deterministic fight exercises offense and defense; it is not a balance benchmark or manual keyboard bout.
